import subprocess,json,hashlib,datetime
rows=[]
for name,expected in [("catalog.html","be773e3953eecc72b7dbdf9fc03ae2e9a307d18a0f1b32ea759c84da23b0bc1c"),("demo.html","c7f1877facf1c62c741373b6bd03b645ec351af3457da06c45988efde805701a")]:
 url="https://jacobmetoyer.com/RecallWeave/"+name
 command=["/usr/bin/curl","--disable","--fail","--silent","--show-error","--location","--proto","=https","--proto-redir","=https","--max-time","20","--max-filesize","524288","--header","Cache-Control: no-cache","--write-out","\nCURL_METADATA %{http_code} %{url_effective}\n",url]
 result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,timeout=25)
 assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[:1000]
 body,metadata=result.stdout.rsplit(b"\nCURL_METADATA ",1)
 status,final_url=metadata.decode().strip().split(" ",1)
 digest=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
 rows.append({"url":url,"final_url":final_url,"status":int(status),"bytes":len(body),"sha256":digest,"git_blob":hashlib.sha1(("blob "+str(len(body))+"\0").encode()+body).hexdigest(),"expected_sha256":expected,"exact":digest==expected,"transport":"/usr/bin/curl with normal TLS verification; HTTPS-only redirects"})
print(json.dumps({"checked_at":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"source_merge":"81363271da63c5428fcb4cafba39fc89c3557b82","rows":rows}))
assert all(row["exact"] and row["status"]==200 for row in rows),"Live source differs"
